description: This file contains server-side handlers for plugin-related HTTP requests in the Mattermost server, including serving plugin requests, internal plugin requests, inter-plugin requests, and public plugin files, with authentication and CSRF validation.

classes.name: Channels
classes.description: Contains methods for handling plugin-related HTTP requests, including serving plugin files and requests.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Application context with methods for internal plugin request handling and logging.

classes.name: plugin.Context
classes.description: Context object passed to plugin HTTP handlers, containing request metadata.

methods.name: ServePluginRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming plugin requests, routing to plugin-specific handlers.

methods.name: ServeInternalPluginRequest
methods.description: Handles internal requests to plugins, setting authentication headers and routing.

methods.name: ServeInterPluginRequest
methods.description: Handles inter-plugin HTTP requests without user authentication headers.

methods.name: ServePluginPublicRequest
methods.description: Serves static public files for plugins.

methods.name: servePluginRequest
methods.description: Internal method to process plugin requests with authentication, CSRF validation, and context setup.

methods.name: validateCSRFForPluginRequest
methods.description: Validates CSRF tokens for plugin requests, with support for backward compatibility.
